2608.21156.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence
2608.21156.paper_summary: LLMs have evolved from language generators to autonomous agents capable of complex, long-horizon tasks. This evolution has produced paradigms including Prompt Engineering to elicit model capabilities, Context Engineering to manage information access, Harness Engineering to organize external tools and resources, and Loop Engineering to support continual reflection and self-improvement. Yet as tasks grow more complex, individual intelligence faces a fundamental limit: many tasks require heterogeneous expertise, interdependent subtasks, parallel execution, independent verification, and persistent state, exceeding any single agent's organizational capacity. Augmenting one agent's capabilities or context cannot resolve this architectural mismatch; intelligence must instead be distributed across specialized agents and organized at the system level. We call this System Intelligence: an agent system's ability to organize and coordinate multiple intelligent components into a coherent, adaptive whole pursuing a shared objective. Achieving it requires more than adding agents; it demands explicit structures to organize work, coordinate heterogeneous agents, and maintain evolving execution states. We introduce Graph Engineering, an emerging paradigm for next-generation agent systems. Unlike prior paradigms that mainly optimize individual interactions or agent-level behavior, Graph Engineering constructs explicit, dynamic, evolving graph structures representing tasks, agents, and system states. These abstractions provide a unified foundation for organizing complex objectives, orchestrating heterogeneous agents, modeling system dynamics, and enabling scalable agent evolution. We systematically review the principles, methodologies, and applications of Graph Engineering for LLM agents. Related papers, open-source data, and projects are collected at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/Awesome-Graph-Engineering.
2608.21156.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 已經從語言生成器演變為能夠執行複雜的長期任務的自主代理。這一演變產生了包括提示工程以引出模型能力、上下文工程以管理信息訪問、工具和資源組織的工具工程，以及支持持續反思和自我改進的循環工程等範式。然後，隨著任務變得越來越複雜，個體智能面臨著根本的限制：許多任務需要異質專業知識、相互依賴的子任務、並行執行、獨立驗證和持久狀態，這超出了任何單一代理的組織能力。增強一個代理的能力或上下文無法解決這種架構不匹配；智能必須分佈在專門的代理之間，並在系統層面上進行組織。我們稱之為系統智能：一個代理系統組織和協調多個智能組件成為一個一致的、自適應的整體，以追求共同目標的能力。實現這一目標需要的不僅僅是增加代理；它需要明確的結構來組織工作、協調異質代理並維持不斷演變的執行狀態。我們介紹圖工程，這是一個新興的下一代代理系統範式。與主要優化個體互動或代理級行為的先前範式不同，圖工程構建了明確的、動態的、演變的圖結構，代表任務、代理和系統狀態。這些抽象提供了一個統一的基礎，用於組織複雜的目標、協調異質代理、建模系統動態以及實現可擴展的代理演變。我們系統性地回顧了圖工程在 LLM 代理中的原則、方法論和應用。相關論文、開源數據和項目已收集在 https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/Awesome-Graph-Engineering。
